verdict.rationale: Luma is an AI video generator, so audio-driven lip-sync is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no feature that takes user dialogue audio and syncs character lip movement to it. Facial-expression transfer from source video and agents that work across 'audio' are adjacent capabilities, not audio-matched lip-sync.

support.subject: As a creator, generated characters speak my dialogue with lip movement matched to the audio
